name: bugnexus
description: BUGNEXUS 2.0 — Full-Stack Bug Tracking & Developer Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run --workspace server prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: npm run --workspace server prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: npm run --workspace server prisma db seed
